pricingEvidence.evidence: Web search summary: "On yearly billing, Free is $0, Basic is $10 a month and Pro is $30 a month; on monthly billing, Basic is $15 and Pro is $45… The Free tier allows 3 websites built on a framer.website subdomain with their branding in the footer."

plans.name: Basic
plans.quota: Custom domain; 50 GB bandwidth and 2 CMS collections

nl.tagline: Websites ontwerpen en publiceren zonder code, met AI
nl.description: Framer, opgericht in Amsterdam, is een visuele websitebouwer waarmee je professionele, geanimeerde sites ontwerpt en direct publiceert, met CMS, vertalingen en AI om pagina's te genereren. Populair bij startups en ontwerpers.
bestFor: Ontwerpers die volledige visuele controle willen
limitations: Gratis plan alleen op een Framer-subdomein met Framer-branding

en.tagline: Design and publish websites without code, with AI
en.description: Framer, founded in Amsterdam, is a visual website builder for designing and publishing professional, animated sites, with a CMS, localisation and AI to generate pages. Popular with startups and designers.
bestFor: Sleek marketing sites and landing pages
Designers who want full visual control
limitations: Free plan only on a Framer subdomain with Framer branding
